نقتو (form VIII)
# نَقْتَوِ (naqtawi) /naq.ta.wi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
# نُقْتَوَ (nuqtawa) /nuq.ta.wa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِقْتَوَى (iqtawā)
